task.title: Update HP LaserJet Driver Installation for Windows 11
task.shortdesc: Steps to install the HP LaserJet driver on Windows 11 and update network timeout configuration.

taskbody.prereq: Ensure that your Windows 11 system is up to date and that you have administrative privileges.

step.cmd: Download the latest HP LaserJet driver from the official HP website.
step.result: The driver package is saved to your computer.

step.cmd: Locate the downloaded driver package and double-click to start the installation.
Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation.
step.result: The HP LaserJet driver is installed on your system.

step.cmd: Configure the network settings as needed.
step.result: The printer is connected to the network.
